notes_for_editor: Disagreements stated in text: lens before 1881 (fifth 1855 NEL; fourth 1857 LHF; NRHP fifth), Judson end 1919 vs 1921, Petzolt/McCoart dates, fog signal 1858 vs 1864, siren 1910 vs 1911, Agnes Judson rescue details. Agnes, Lottie Lillingston, mermaid and 1837/1850 inspection items are second-hand (LHF/NEL); no newspaper or inspection report was read (newspapers.py search returned nothing; corpus holds LHB only from 1891). Pre-1891 Light-House Board reports not checked. USCG historian page not reachable. Current ownership after 2025 application not confirmed; CT Post says Coast Guard vacated 2019 while LHF says last occupant left 2018. Tower height: record says 11.0 m; NRHP 35 ft to focal plane. Current tours schedule not verified (town page empty to the reader). Printed page for the 1895 oil-house entry (p. 63) is taken from the report's index, scan page 248; not read on the page image. USLHS shows 'Open to Public: No' while LighthouseFriends and the town offer tours. Nomination dates the first lighting apparatus to 1821 although the station was established 1822.
